post.title: [Hiring] Senior Client-Facing Software Developer | LATAM | Fully Remote | Part-Time | $20–$40 USD/hour
post.body:
'm looking for a senior software developer based in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, or Colombia to work with me on a long-term, part-time basis.

Alongside development work, you'll speak directly with clients, clarify requirements, explain technical solutions, and contribute ideas.

What I offer

* $20–$40 USD/hour, based on experience and communication skills
* Fully remote work
* Flexible, part-time schedule
* Long-term collaboration

What I'm looking for

* 7+ years of professional software development experience
* C1+ English, spoken and written, with confidence communicating with clients
* Strong understanding of web development and the software development lifecycle
* Professionalism, reliability, and the ability to work independently
* Availability to coordinate with North American clients

Experience with React, Node.js, Laravel, or .NET is a plus.

Interested?

After upvote and send me a message with your country of residence, years of experience, main stack, expected hourly rate, and a short introduction about a project you're proud of.

I'll share more details about the work and how we'd collaborate.

analysis.summary: Seeking a senior software developer based in Latin America for long-term, part-time development and client-facing tasks.

expect: does not claim to live in or be eligible as a resident of Mexico, Brazil, Argentina or Colombia (the profile is in the UK)
does not claim 7+ years of professional experience unless the evidence shows it
mentions React or Node.js, which the post lists, and cites one real project
